prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic documentary adventure photograph. A guarded treasure attempt visibly failing unfolds at hard winter dawn: a guarded hidden-treasure recovery attempt visibly failing. In a layered medium-wide documentary frame, an unmistakably adult climber reaches one gloved hand into a cliff niche. One clearly adult seeker is the identifiable recovery actor, braced at the wet ledge. The adult seeker actively reaches digs opens or lifts toward that exact cache, here extending one gloved hand. One hidden cache remains visibly attached to its soil masonry or fixed niche, recessed behind the stone barrier. One identifiable guardian directly interrupts the same access path, swinging a fitted slab between glove and cache. The transfer visibly fails and the treasure remains at the site, sealed behind the descending fitted slab. At a shoulder-height oblique vantage in the instant before closure, the closing slab becomes a moving aperture: the treasure flashes through its narrowing gap while the reaching glove is cut off by stone. Read the frame as foreground climber first, closing guardian second, recessed treasure last. The treasure's full outline stays partly withheld, and wet stone alone carries the cold dawn reflections. Image 1 supplies observable appearance cues: long, softly waved near-black hair with a center part, almond-shaped brown eyes, softly defined brows, fine dark eyeliner, luminous natural makeup, and peach-pink lips. Cold directional light, realistic skin texture, damp mineral detail, restrained film grain.
